method: Held-out trigger eval. A judge sees ONLY the skill's frontmatter `description` (the real selection signal) plus the prompt, and predicts whether the debug skill should fire. Predictions are scored against the `expected` gold labels below → precision/recall. Bar: 100% positive recall, 0 false-positives. LLM-judged, so a results snapshot may vary slightly between runs.

cases.prompt: why does this test keep failing?
the app crashes on startup, help me figure out why
this test is flaky — sometimes passes, sometimes fails
debug this stack trace for me
find the root cause of this null pointer exception
it worked before my last commit, now it's broken
the API returns a 500, track down why
wrong output: expected 5 but got -1, what's going on?
there's a memory leak somewhere, help me find it
this function returns undefined and I can't tell why
production threw this error overnight, what's the root cause?
my cargo test panics with index out of bounds
add a dark mode toggle to the settings page
review this login screen for design quality
write tests for the new payment module
rename the getUser function to fetchUser across the repo
what's the latest version of the Anthropic SDK?
